newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Filo to propose capital increase.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Filo to propose capital increase.

text.p: Spanish real estate firm Filo will propose reducing the firm's share capital to 1.88 billion pesetas and then increasing it by 2.35 billion pesetas, the stock exchange watchdog CNMV said on Friday.
Filo will propose first reducing its share capital by 5.28 billion pesetas to re-establish the firm's equity balance, the CNMV said.
The firm will cut the nominal value of its shares to 100 pesetas, bringing its share capital to 1.88 billion pesetas. These shares will be known as Series A stock.

At the same time, the firm will increase its share capital by 2.35 billion pesetas via an issue of 23.5 million preferred shares with a nominal value of 100 pesetas. These shares will be Series B stock and will have an issue premium of 110 pesetas, the CNMV said.
The firm will also apply the reserve for its own shares to a free disposal reserve to compensate for losses, the CNMV said.
The CNMV said these proposals were the result of an agreement with Bankers Trust and would be proposed to shareholders at the next annual meeting on June 30.
